author: Zafl0
body:
The only thing I can agree with you upon is that a banned account should be deleted. But I guess Odie needs to keep the account 'live' for some time in case there would be some sort of investigation. But that's just my guess.

When Odie banned 2 or 3 of your accounts, that should've already been a sign to you to stop if you'd care enough about others yet you continued as far as 17 accounts. 

It's nice you've wanted to create a community of players but what did you expect will happen in the future? All forgiven even though you've broken the ToS several times? That's not how the real world works unfortunately.

You are the reason those Kingdoms are dying and if you didn't explain the reason to them already, you should do so now. The players should just move on to other guilds. In the end, this whole mess was created because of many mistakes in the past.

If it's really a community and a big one as you've described it then I don't see why those Kingdoms can't restart from the beginning. Shouldn't take long and they'd just have to pay the price for your mistakes.

TLDR; I personally don't think anything should be forgiven as you've broken the ToS several times, even once would be enough yet you continued. If you were to do crime 2 - 3 times or 17 times, it's still crime.

The punishment has to be at least this harsh otherwise others will be encouraged to follow in your footsteps.
